text:
jia: hi folks, day 2 and hitting a wall. connected with the WireGuard profile on mac (Ventura) using split-tunnel. public sites load but `npm install` against our private registry (registry.redwood.internal) fails. i can ssh to bastion and curl the registry from there, but from my laptop the DNS for registry.redwood.internal doesn't resolve. any quick fixes?

mira: welcome jia! quick question: what does `dig +short registry.redwood.internal` show on your laptop vs the bastion? also which WireGuard client and profile did you use?

jia: used the mac built-in wg-quick profile we gave in onboarding. dig returns nothing locally; on bastion `dig +short registry.redwood.internal` -> 10.3.12.8.

toni: sounds like split-DNS not pushed to the client. the gateway only pushes routes for private subnets, not DNS records. two quick workarounds: 1) SSH local port forward to the registry, or 2) temporary /etc/hosts entry (only OK for http, worse for TLS unless you manage certs).

jia: tried /etc/hosts with the IP but npm hits an SSL cert mismatch (internal cert with SAN registry.redwood.internal).

mira: yeah hosts won't fix TLS. easiest short-term: tunnel the service via SSH. example: `ssh -L 4873:10.3.12.8:4873 ubuntu@bastion.redwood` then `npm set registry http://localhost:4873` (or set proxy). that avoids touching system CA.

jia: i tried `ssh -L` and it worked for installs, thanks! any way to make it persistent so i don't have to run the command every time?

toni: add this to `~/.ssh/config`:
```
Host bastion-redwood
  HostName bastion.redwood
  User ubuntu
  LocalForward 4873 10.3.12.8:4873
  ServerAliveInterval 60
```
then `ssh bastion-redwood` opens the tunnel. you can also run it in background with `-fN` if you want.

devops-bot: FYI, we prefer to limit long-running tunnels. opening ticket to patch split-DNS config for WG profiles: https://infra.redwood/tickets/5237 (internal).

mira: opened ticket #5237 assigned to network team to add registry.redwood.internal to VPN split-dns and push the resolver. ETA one business day.

it-bot: created ticket #5237: "add registry.redwood.internal to split-DNS for WG profiles" assigned to @toni.

jia: awesome, thanks all! that tunnel tip saved my afternoon. small ask for onboarding docs: could we mention the tunnel option and the ssh config snippet? i nearly spent an hour debugging.

mira: good call — i'll add a short note to the new-hire checklist and link to the ssh example in the help doc.

jia: appreciate it :heart:
